mask_roms.source: tools/fetch-rom-elfs.sh roms (espressif/esp-rom-elfs, pinned by SHA-256 in the script)

firmware.sketches: wifi-net-probe.ino (scan with channel, signal and security, then join the board's network) and wifi-home-probe.ino (WiFi.begin("Home", "home-pass-123") with a 20 s timeout), this directory
firmware.build: arduino-cli 1.5.1, Arduino-ESP32 core 3.3.12 (ESP-IDF v5.5.5); the core's WiFi library
firmware.fqbn: esp32:esp32:esp32s3 (default options: 4 MB quad flash, DIO)

bootloader.bin.note: the core's default S3 bootloader, 4 MB flash header

firmware.not_committed: Plain Arduino builds of the sketches; not added to the repository.

runs.scan: esp32sim --rom roms/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf --boot rom --board none --flash-mb 4 --bootloader bootloader.bin --ptable partitions.bin --app wifi-net.bin --wifi ssid=Jumperly --net none --wifi-nearby ssid=Home,chan=1,rssi=-60 --wifi-nearby ssid=Cafe,chan=11,rssi=-75,secure=0 --wifi-nearby ssid=Office,chan=6,rssi=-82,bssid=02:00:00:00:00:42 --console uart0 --max-seconds 12 --no-dump
runs.join: esp32sim ... --app wifi-home.bin --wifi ssid=Jumperly --net none --wifi-nearby ssid=Home,chan=1 --console uart0 --max-seconds 30 --no-dump
runs.control: the scan run without --wifi-nearby, and the join run on main 9890ac55 (no such option: the sketch sees only the board's network)
